audience.text: Developers building .NET 8+ applications who need to process PDF documents without licensing costs, especially those migrating from Aspose.PDF for .NET or seeking a drop-in replacement for common PDF tasks.

capabilities.text: Create new documents or open existing ones, add/delete/reorder pages, and save with full round-trip support for bookmarks, outlines, page labels, named destinations, document info, XMP metadata, and optional content layers.
capabilities.title: Create and modify PDF documents

capabilities.text: Extract text using TextAbsorber and TextFragmentAbsorber, find and replace text across pages including ligature-aware spans, and build new text with TextFragment, TextStamp, and FormattedText.
capabilities.title: Extract and replace text

capabilities.text: Read, fill, and build AcroForm fields including text, checkbox, radio, choice, button, signature, and rich text, with field-level flatten and JSON/XFDF export/import.
capabilities.title: Process interactive forms

capabilities.text: Add and edit standard annotation types including link, text, free-text, highlight, ink, stamp, popup, file attachment, redaction, and pre-press marks with appearance generation.
capabilities.title: Add annotations and stamps

capabilities.text: Encrypt documents with RC4-40, RC4-128, AES-128, and AES-256, and sign using PKCS#7/CMS detached signatures including DocMDP certifying signatures.
capabilities.title: Encrypt and sign documents

capabilities.text: Render pages to PNG, JPEG, BMP, TIFF, or SVG using pluggable devices with mesh shading, JBIG2 decoding, and JPEG/JPEG2000/CCITT-Fax filter support.
capabilities.title: Render pages to images and SVG

capabilities.text: Convert PDF to and from HTML and SVG, load Markdown, XML, or plain-text files, and export to Markdown, plain text, or PDF/A (1A through 4F).
capabilities.title: Convert between formats

capabilities.text: Compare two documents or pages using SideBySidePdfComparer for text-based differences or GraphicalPdfComparer for pixel-level diffs (Windows only).
capabilities.title: Compare documents

limitations.text: AI/LowCode workflows (Aspose.Pdf.AI.*, Aspose.Pdf.LowCode.*) are out of scope; use Aspose.PDF for .NET Enterprise Edition for AI-powered features.
Multithreading APIs are not included; this edition is single-threaded for a single Document instance.
Format converters are limited to PDF, HTML, SVG, Markdown, and XML; DOCX, EPUB, MHT, XPS, PCL, LaTeX, DJVU, OFD, PostScript, and CGM conversion are not included.
TiffDevice.BinarizeBradley and DocumentCollection.GetEnumerator() are not implemented and throw NotImplementedException.
Advanced digital signature validation options (ValidationOptions, OCSP, network timestamping) are stored but not active.
Rendering output is pixel-close but not byte-identical to Aspose.PDF for .NET Enterprise Edition due to differences in sub-pixel positioning, dithering, and anti-aliasing.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic PDF creation, editing, and conversion using a familiar API surface without requiring a commercial license.
Supports text extraction, form filling, annotation management, and document security (encryption and signing) through dedicated APIs.
Provides rendering to raster and vector formats (PNG, JPEG, SVG) and conversion between PDF, HTML, SVG, Markdown, and plain text.

product_summary.text: Aspose.PDF FOSS for .NET is a free, open-source .NET 8+ library for reading, creating, modifying, and converting PDF documents with an API surface compatible with Aspose.PDF for .NET.

uncertainties: The exact scope of 'limited' XFA authoring capabilities is not specified beyond basic read/flatten and dataset round-tripping.
Whether 'basic' digital signatures include PKCS#1 support is implied but not explicitly confirmed by the public symbols.
The behavior of DocumentCollection.GetEnumerator() on non-implemented platforms is not detailed beyond throwing NotImplementedException.

workflows.name: Create and edit PDF documents
workflows.text: Create a new document using Document.Create(), add pages, insert text fragments, and save the result to disk.

workflows.name: Extract and replace text
workflows.text: Use TextAbsorber or TextFragmentAbsorber to find text, then modify fragments and save the updated document.

workflows.name: Add annotations and stamps
workflows.text: Open an existing PDF, add link annotations with URI actions, or insert stamp annotations on specific pages.

workflows.name: Process interactive forms
workflows.text: Open a PDF with form fields, iterate over fields in Document.Form.Fields, and read or modify their values.

workflows.name: Render pages to images or SVG
workflows.text: Use SvgDevice, PngDevice, or other image devices to convert PDF pages to vector or raster formats.

workflows.name: Encrypt and sign documents
workflows.text: Apply encryption with user/owner passwords and AES-256, or sign documents using PKCS#7 certificates.
